caseName: United Gas Improvement Co. v. Commissioner
caseNameFull: United Gas Improvement Co. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. John H. Minds and William R. Spofjord for petitioner., Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Samuel O. Clark, Jr., and Messrs. Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch, L. W. Post, and Walter J. Cummings, Jr. for respondent.
